rubrics_metrics.name: Legal definition/protection of 'substitute' (ersatz) in Germany
rubrics_metrics.description: Substitute chocolate must look like chocolate, taste like it and have the same nutritive properties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Context: Because of chronic shortages of raw materials some substitutes are regarded as superior to national products, but some unprincipled producers were making fake substitutes. Germany gave legal protection to the words for substitute ('ersatz') and defined a substitute such that, for example, substitute chocolate must resemble chocolate in appearance, flavor and nutritive content. This definition was adopted to prevent deceptive or fake substitutes.
